# PDF Reading

```{r}
# read pdf into R
raw_pdf_text <- pdf_text("2025-select-fall-adrb-tables-2-0.pdf")

# extracting specific page for testing

page_37 <- raw_pdf_text[37]
cat(page_37)
```
Attempting to create a function for table extraction.
```{r}
target_pages <- 36:40

extract_adrb_table <- function(page_num) {
  # getting text for one page and splitting into lines
  lines <- raw_text[page_num] |> read_lines()
  
  # reomving headers and footers
  clean_lines <- lines[!str_detect(lines, "ADRB|Page|Table 1-5C | School/")]
  
  # converting to tibble
  df <- tibble(raw_line = clean_lines) |> 
    # removing empty lines
    filter(raw_line != "") |> 
    # identifying major and counts
    mutate(
      major_name = str_extract(raw_line, "^[A-Za-z &,-/]+"),  
      counts_raw = str_remove(raw_line, "^[A-Za-z &,-/]+")
    ) |> 
    # trimming whitespace
    mutate(across(everything(), str_squish)) |> 
    filter(!is.na(major_name), major_name != "Total")
  
  return(df)
}

```
